text.description_html:
Laurey 99924, Nantucket Cabinet Pull in Antique Pewter

The Antique Pewter Nantucket Knot Cabinet Pull has the coastal grandma aesthetic; it is perfect for seaside homes and homes with nautical decor that want something fresh for this year. The Nantucket Cabinet Pull in Antique Pewter will contrast beautifully with dark kitchen cabinets. It has a standard 3 inch center to center mounting and is 4.5 inches overall. The Laurey 99924 3 Inch Nantucket Pull in Antique Pewter comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Nantucket Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 99924 3 Inch Nantucket Pull in Antique Pewter:

  • Material: Steel
  • Finish: Antique Pewter
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.

Available finishes:
Antique Pewter Satin Pewter Matte Black

Sold Individually
